judge: judge-2 (independent sample: paragraph 2 then every third paragraph; 48 paragraphs sampled, 15 claims drawn from them)

score_notes.A: Coherent arc: TL;DR (L11-15) -> problem (L17) -> units (L62) -> request lifetime (L135) -> composition (L206) -> autoscaling (L403) -> fault tolerance (L480) -> local loop (L531) -> FastAPI (L619) -> config (L718) -> KubeRay (L838) -> capacity (L892) -> observability (L944) -> verdict (L993). Front matter ok (no author, two-level categories, use_math with $$, description 131 chars). Deductions: box-drawing text diagrams whose borders break with Korean width (L45-49, L417-419); trivial arithmetic typeset as display math ($$40 / 2 = 20$$, L472); a blank double line before H2 (L529-531, L617-619).
score_notes.B: Mostly natural Korean in 입니다 register. Deductions: the same figure-intro frame three times ('예를 들어 ... 상자로 그리면 다음과 같은 모양입니다' L39, '예를 들어 ... 상자로 그리면 다음과 같습니다' L411, '예를 들어 그려 보면 다음 그림과 같습니다' L870) -> vary or drop; formulaic lead-ins 'X를 나란히 놓으면 다음 표가 됩니다' (L253), '한데 모으면 이렇습니다' (L393), '갈림길은 요청 객체 크기 하나입니다' (L183, restates L181); filler '이렇게 나누면 역할이 분명해집니다' (L148); inconsistent term 'Kubernetes' vs '쿠버네티스' (L968).
score_notes.C: Good back-references (L425, L512, L581). Deductions: the running example's route prefix wobbles: L602 tells the reader to POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/summarize, L663-665 says /text/summarize and that the config sets /text, yet the config actually shown at L732-754 and later at L900/L923 keeps route_prefix: / (only the RayService copy at L844 uses /text). The config with Translator user_config (L732) is presented before reconfigure is introduced (L758-805), so the order of steps does not work (confirmed at runtime).
score_notes.D: Hard parts get worked examples: autoscaling arithmetic (L472), cancellation traced through summarize_and_translate (L703), GPU count table (L937). Deductions: the whole Translator block appears twice verbatim (L85-117 and L543-579) and the pip install line twice (L82, L536); the 100KiB rule gets a paragraph, a one-line restatement and a table (L181-190).
score_notes.E: Tables are real and well placed (proxy_location L198, failure table L504, call-mode table L395). Deductions: duplicated 31-line code block (L85 vs L543); redundant 2-row table restating the previous sentence (L185-188); no image of the docs' architecture diagram, only ASCII art with broken alignment.
score_notes.F: Wrong: L123 '`bind`는 디플로이먼트 객체를 감싼 `DeploymentNode`를 돌려줍니다' - on Ray 2.60.0 Translator.bind() returns ray.serve.deployment.Application (verified at runtime); schema.DeploymentNode in the API index is a topology-schema class, not bind's return. Unsupported: L35 'TensorFlow라면 어떤 버전이든 쓸 수 있습니다' (not on index or any fetched page); L935/L942 PENDING replicas and 'vLLM으로 올린 메인 LLM은 정수 GPU만 받는다' attributed to agents-lib, not present on the fetched agents-lib page; L260 'Spheron 블로그' and L1014 'TrueFoundry 블로그의 2026년 비교 글' are cited in the body but absent from Sources and unlinked (unverifiable). Writer's numbers are labelled as examples (L472, L935).
score_notes.T1: Most code runs as pasted (quickstart, Summarizer+Translator composition, pipeline_app, _to_object_ref example, streaming handle example, FastAPI ingress, StreamingResponder). But the Serve config files the guide deploys (L732, L844, L900) set user_config on Translator while the Translator the reader has written has no reconfigure method: DEPLOY_FAILED 'user_config or rank specified but deployment ... missing reconfigure method'. The reconfigure snippet (L764-805) is a 'changed lines only' fragment (translate/summarize do not return), so no complete text_ml.py that matches the YAML exists in the post.
score_notes.T2: Covers the topics the sources support in a sensible order (concepts, architecture, composition, autoscaling, FT, dev loop, HTTP, config, KubeRay, observability). Minor padding: Serve LLM usage-data collection (L991) and the examples catalogue (L1010).
score_notes.T3: Internals explained with mechanism and reason (request lifetime, handle data path, object-store threshold, controller-hosted autoscaler, checkpoint scope, proxy health/draining), fit into the system (Ray Autoscaler two-layer scaling, KubeRay/GCS FT, external scaler, dashboard security), closes with when to choose and gaps. Version-labelled history (2.32.0 default change, Ray 2.0 talk) correctly framed. Deduction: the DeploymentNode remark is an old-API detail stated as current.

claim_headings.evidence: H2s are claim noun phrases, e.g. '큐 길이를 기준으로 하는 컨트롤러 내장 오토스케일러' (L403), '분산·합성 서빙에는 강하고 모델 최적화·플랫폼 기능은 빠진 도구' (L993).

running_example.evidence: Summarize-then-translate app threads through every section (L25, L214, L627, L732, L844, L952), but its config/code and route prefix do not stay consistent (L602 vs L665; L732 user_config vs Translator without reconfigure).
